title: Re-Verifying Benefits on an Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Patient Services Center training note — Insured Plan of Care benefit re-verification.**

**Rule.** Benefits on an active or on-hold plan are re-verified at least every benefit re-verification interval of the payer program, in calendar days, after the benefits verified date on file, and, where the payer program re-verifies each calendar year, before the first visit in a new calendar year, when deductibles and visit counts reset. Re-verification replaces the copay, coinsurance, deductible, visit limit, visits used elsewhere and Medicare allowed-to-date figures with the payer's current answer; charges already posted are not recalculated except through the permitted balance adjustments of the Insured Plan of Care.

## Questions and answers

**Which plans are re-verified?** Plans in active or on-hold status.

**What changes on the plan when benefits are re-verified?** The copay, coinsurance percentage, remaining deductible, calendar-year visit limit, visits used elsewhere and Medicare allowed amount accrued elsewhere are replaced with the payer's current answer, and the benefits verified date becomes the date of that verification.

**Does a new copay or deductible change charges that are already on the balance?** No. Charges already posted are not recalculated except through the permitted balance adjustments.

**Hypothetical timing.** On a payer program with a 30-day interval, benefits verified on 2026-03-01 are re-verified no later than 2026-03-31. On a program that re-verifies each calendar year, a patient whose last visit was in December is re-verified before the first January visit, even where the interval has not run out.
